what: The Gazette of 11 March 1972 publishes every candidate’s votes and electors by polling division, 135 divisions in all. They are now used, and the electors total the stated 41,529. One ElectionPassport figure was wrong: St. Andrew South West, Sylvester 1,572, not 1,576. The Gazette’s own printed totals disagree with its division rows in St. George North East (Dolland 1,504 printed vs 1,502 summed; O’Neale 1,292 vs 1,337) and St. George North West (Hosten 1,340 vs 1,341). Ballots cast and rejected aren’t published.
action: Printed totals are shown and flagged. Needs the Returning Officers’ statements for those two constituencies.
